content: We first note that our multimodal models achieve the state of the art performance for transformer networks (constrained models) on the English-German dataset, as compared to BIBREF30 . Second, our deliberation models lead to significant improvements over this baseline across test sets (average INLINEFORM0 , INLINEFORM1 ).
